# Research Material
This article explains which unique interactions are available, how to obtain research material, and what it is used for.
# SCP-173
## Mining pickaxe
Use a mining pickaxe on the object to break off a piece of the statue. The resulting fragment functions as an artifact and can be studied to obtain [color=#8b0000]SCP research points[/color].
## Scraping paint
Use a crowbar on the object to scrape off some paint. Place the resulting powder in a microwave to turn it into a clump that can be studied as an artifact to obtain [color=#8b0000]SCP research points[/color].
## Collecting fluid
This is the only interaction that is not performed directly on the object. - Collect the fluid secreted by SCP-173. - Place the fluid in the [bold]reagent synthesizer[/bold] located next to its chamber. [bold]At least 30 units of fluid are required.[/bold] - Wait for the synthesis to finish.
Your test tube may contain a random reagent in a random quantity.
# SCP-999
## Scalpel
Use a scalpel on the object to obtain a piece of jelly. The jelly functions as an artifact and can be studied to obtain [color=#8b0000]SCP research points[/color].
## Feeding
Feed the object donuts to obtain sweet slime. It can be used in recipes to make healing food:
- Bun + jelly = [bold]jelly bun[/bold] - Margherita pizza + jelly = [bold]jelly pizza[/bold]
Some jelly samples may contain ash. It is entirely random.
# SCP-096
## Camera
Use a camera on the object to take a photograph of it. Any crew member who looks at the photograph will automatically see the Shy Guy's face. This will enrage the Shy Guy and make the viewer its target.
# SCP-106
## Collecting fluid
- Collect the rot secreted by SCP-106. - Place the rot in the [bold]reagent synthesizer[/bold] located in the Science department's chemistry block. [bold]At least 30 units of rot are required.[/bold] - Wait for the synthesis to finish.
Your test tube may contain a random reagent in a random quantity.
## Hacksaw
Use a hacksaw on the object to obtain a piece of rotten tissue. It can be ground in a reagent grinder to produce a special rot fluid. The rotten tissue functions as an artifact and can be studied to obtain [color=#8b0000]SCP research points[/color].
